prompt: I have a vague idea about building a notification system for overdue tasks. Help me think through this.
deterministic_check: response mentions 'explore' mode or equivalent open-ended exploration framing
rubric: Did the agent route to explore mode (open questions, divergent) rather than jumping to design or grilling?

prompt: I need to design the architecture for a new MCP server that will query monday.com boards. I want to think through the design properly.
deterministic_check: response classifies as Spike/Bounded/Arch OR asks about design scope before proceeding
rubric: Did the agent route to design mode and apply the Spike/Bounded/Arch classification?

prompt: Grill me on my idea: I want to build a weekly email digest of my GTM metrics.
deterministic_check: response asks exactly ONE question, not multiple questions at once
rubric: Did the agent ask exactly one question (not a list of questions)?

prompt: Use attack mode: my plan is to migrate all GTM tracking to server-side in Q1.
deterministic_check: response identifies at least one failure mode or critical flaw in the plan
rubric: Did the agent use attack mode (adversarial, find flaws) rather than explore or any other mode?

prompt: I want a board of advisors to weigh in on whether to rebuild our attribution model from scratch.
deterministic_check: response invokes multiple named advisor perspectives or personas
rubric: Did the agent route to panel mode and present multiple distinct advisor perspectives?
